_comment: Reference for the command-line flags; the binary is configured with flags, not this file. Copy the values you want onto the command line.
_home_assistant: Optional. Leave mqtt-broker empty and none of this applies — the server behaves exactly as it does without Home Assistant. YOU RUN THE BROKER: install the Mosquitto add-on (or any MQTT broker) on your Home Assistant instance; this project does not provide one. The lamps never talk to the broker, only this server does.
_colour_temperature: The lamps report warmth as a percentage and never state the Kelvin endpoints. 2700-6500 is correct for the aigo_light_cct_v4.0.0; a different model with different endpoints would need these changed.
